description: The caller's timeline: recent activity across every community they belong to, on this PDS and on configured peer PDSes, newest first.

main.description: Gathers activity from each community the caller is a member of: from the database for communities hosted here, and from each configured peer PDS (PEER_PDS_URLS) in parallel, asking with a service-auth token for the caller. A peer that does not answer in time is skipped and named in `unreachable` / `unreachablePeers`; the page is built from what did answer. Requires a session or OAuth token of an account on this PDS; service-auth is refused.

cursor.description: Opaque: the `cursor` of the previous page.
Pass back to fetch the next page. Absent on the last page.

unreachable.description: Communities whose PDS did not answer in time or answered with an error: their activity is missing from this page.

unreachablePeers.description: Peer PDS URLs that could not be asked which communities the caller belongs to there.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A cursor this server did not hand out.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: Called with service-auth, or by an account not hosted here.

id.description: Unique across communities: the record's at-uri, or for an entry with no record a namespaced key. The tie-breaker in the sort order.

kind.description: What happened. Clients should skip kinds they do not know.

actor.description: Who did it. Absent for an event, which the community publishes.

uri.description: The record, when there is one. A join request has none.

createdAt.description: When the community's PDS recorded it, UTC with microseconds. The sort key.
